title: Saudi Arabian Fish Curry
description: A unique velvety fish curry featuring fresh basil and tandoor flavors, perfect for a monsoon evening, this dish is a pescatarian friendly delight with grassy notes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the fish fillets with salt, black pepper, and tandoor masala.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sear the fish fillets until browned on both sides.
Remove the fish from the skillet and set aside.
Add more oil to the skillet if necessary, then saute the chopped onion until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute until the spices are fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Return the fish fillets to the skillet and spoon some of the curry sauce over the top of each fillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes until the fish is cooked through.
Stir in the chopped fresh basil and serve hot.
